I am a 55-year-old farmer in Mangochi with no schooling, and I have farmed this land for many years. Beans do not need much nitrogen because they fix it from the air, so I will not waste money on chemical fertilizer that I cannot afford anyway. I have some manure from my goats and cattle, so I will spread that on the plot before planting, and I will use seed I saved from last season because it has always done well. This plot is small and I have my wife and children to help, so we will manage the work ourselves without hiring anyone, and we depend on the rains since we have no pump or irrigation here.
